title: AgentOrchestrationRunIntakePreviewRequest
description: Request envelope for the read-only Run Intake v2 preview endpoint. It carries only what the browser legitimately owns: the nested Run Intake v2 payload exactly as it would appear inside a create-run v1 body, or an explicit null for a create-run request that has no nested Agent orchestration payload. Every judging input that could forge an accepted verdict is server-owned and therefore not accepted here: expected_revision, registered revisions, profile_records, backend lowering issues, claim_requires_calibration and the dispatcher route are all fixed by the server. additionalProperties is false so a client that tries to supply one of those fields is rejected instead of silently ignored.

intake.description: The nested Agent orchestration submission. An explicit null is the expected-absence case: the create-run v1 accept set is unchanged because no nested payload is present. Omitting the key is a request-validation failure, not an expected absence.
